name: Kashmir Valley Serenity Escape
description: Experience the mesmerizing beauty of Kashmir with this thoughtfully designed 5-day itinerary. This journey takes you through the scenic valleys of Pahalgam, the serene landscapes of Srinagar, and the breathtaking destinations of Gulmarg and Sonmarg.
route: Srinagar → Pahalgam → Srinagar → Gulmarg → Sonmarg → Srinagar
highlights: Scenic drive from Srinagar to Pahalgam
Explore famous valleys – Aru, Betaab, Baisaran, and Chandanwari
Visit Gulmarg, a popular hill station and winter skiing destination
Experience the famous Gulmarg Gondola ride (optional)
Full-day excursion to Sonmarg – "Meadow of Gold"
Enjoy the beauty of the Sindh River
Complimentary Shikara ride on Dal Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar – Transfer to Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: Arrival at Srinagar Airport. Meet and greet by representative. Drive to Pahalgam. Check-in at hotel. Dinner and overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing – Transfer to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Visit Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, Baisaran, and Chandanwari. Later drive to Srinagar. Dinner and overnight in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Morning drive to Gulmarg. Explore the hill station known for skiing. Optional Gondola ride. Return to Srinagar. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Full-day trip to Sonmarg. Enjoy scenic views of Sindh River. Optional pony ride to glacier. Return to Srinagar in evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at hotel. Transfer to Srinagar Airport. Departure with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Parking charges, toll taxes, fuel, and driver expenses
exclusions: Medical assistance, medicines, or doctor on call
Entry fees at monuments or attractions
Adventure activities (skiing, paragliding, Gondola ride, etc.)
